passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: The resolution's operative text bars recognition of any marriage other than one man and one woman, matching both clauses of rung 5.

rows.reasoning: Lehman co-authored HJR 3 (2014) and voted Yea on its House passage. The resolution's operative text, 'Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana', bars recognition of same-sex marriage while defining marriage as one man and one woman, matching both operative clauses of 'Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman.'
